item.description: There are 14 active measles cases and 112 people are being isolated at the facility.

item.title: Fearing GOP upset, top California Democrat urges lagging candidates for governor to drop out of race
item.description: The all-GOP general election is possible under California's unusual top-two primary system.

item.title: Florida bill to expand vaccine exemptions for schoolkids heads to Senate floor
item.description: A Florida bill that would create a new “conscience” category for parents to opt their children out of vaccines typically required for public K-12 schools is headed to the Senate floor.

item.description: The Knights didn't have an answer for the visiting Cowboys, who handed them their second consecutive loss.

item.title: Jack Hughes, Devils deal Panthers’ playoff hopes another blow
item.description: Florida is in danger of becoming the first Cup-winning team to miss the playoffs the following season since Los Angeles in 2014-15. The Panthers have lost three of their past four.
